versos.grego: Ἔπειτα διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν πάλιν ἀνέβην εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα μετὰ Βαρνάβα συνπαραλαβὼν καὶ Τίτον·

controles.web: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.
controles.kjv: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
controles.livre: Depois de passados catorze anos, subi outra vez a Jerusalém com Barnabé, levando comigo também Tito.

versos.grego: ἀνέβην δὲ κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν· καὶ ἀνεθέμην αὐτοῖς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ὃ κηρύσσω ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, κατ’ ἰδίαν δὲ τοῖς δοκοῦσιν, μή πως εἰς κενὸν τρέχω ἢ ἔδραμον.

controles.web: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.
controles.kjv: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
controles.livre: E, por causa de uma revelação, subi, e lhes declarei o Evangelho que prego entre os gentios. Isso , porém, foi em particular, com os mais influentes,  para que eu eu não corresse ou tivesse corrido em vão.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ Τίτος ὁ σὺν ἐμοί, Ἕλλην ὤν, ἠναγκάσθη περιτμηθῆναι·

controles.web: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
controles.kjv: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
controles.livre: Porém nem mesmo Tito, que estava comigo, sendo grego, foi obrigado a se circuncidar.

versos.grego: διὰ δὲ τοὺς παρεισάκτους ψευδαδέλφους, οἵτινες παρεισῆλθον κατασκοπῆσαι τὴν ἐλευθερίαν ἡμῶν ἣν ἔχομεν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ, ἵνα ἡμᾶς καταδουλώσουσιν·

controles.web: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;
controles.kjv: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage:
controles.livre: E isso por causa de falsos irmãos, que haviam se infiltrado, e entraram secretamente para espionar a nossa liberdade que temos em Cristo Jesus, a fim de nos tornar escravos.

versos.grego: οἷς οὐδὲ πρὸς ὥραν εἴξαμεν τῇ ὑποταγῇ, ἵνα ἡ ἀλήθεια τοῦ εὐαγγελίου διαμείνῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
controles.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
controles.livre: A eles nem sequer por um momento  cedemos a nos sujeitarmos, para que a verdade do Evangelho permanecesse em vós.

versos.grego: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν δοκούντων εἶναί τι, —ὁποῖοί ποτε ἦσαν οὐδέν μοι διαφέρει· πρόσωπον ὁ Θεὸς ἀνθρώπου οὐ λαμβάνει— ἐμοὶ γὰρ οἱ δοκοῦντες οὐδὲν προσανέθεντο,

controles.web: But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man)—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,
controles.kjv: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it maketh no matter to me: God accepteth no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
controles.livre: E quanto aos de maior influência (o que haviam sido antes não me importa; Deus não se interessa na aparência humana); esses, pois, que eram influentes, nada me acrescentaram.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ τοὐναντίον ἰδόντες ὅτι πεπίστευμαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς ἀκροβυστίας καθὼς Πέτρος τῆς περιτομῆς,

controles.web: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision
controles.kjv: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
controles.livre: Pelo contrário, quando viram que o Evangelho aos incircuncisos  havia sido confiado a mim, assim como a Pedro, aos circuncisos,

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ἐνεργήσας Πέτρῳ εἰς ἀποστολὴν τῆς περιτομῆς ἐνήργησεν καὶ ἐμοὶ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη,

controles.web: (for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles);
controles.kjv: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
controles.livre: (pois aquele que operou em Pedro para o apostolado da circuncisão, esse operou também em mim para os gentios)

versos.grego: καὶ γνόντες τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι, Ἰάκωβος καὶ Κηφᾶς καὶ Ἰωάνης, οἱ δοκοῦντες στῦλοι εἶναι, δεξιὰς ἔδωκαν ἐμοὶ καὶ Βαρνάβα κοινωνίας, ἵνα ἡμεῖς εἰς τὰ ἔθνη, αὐτοὶ δὲ εἰς τὴν περιτομήν·

controles.web: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.
controles.kjv: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
controles.livre: e quando Tiago, Cefas, e João, que eram considerados como colunas, reconheceram a graça que me foi dada, eles estenderam as mãos direitas de comunhão a mim e a Barnabé, para que nós fôssemos aos gentios, e eles aos circuncisos;

versos.grego: μόνον τῶν πτωχῶν ἵνα μνημονεύωμεν, ὃ καὶ ἐσπούδασα αὐτὸ τοῦτο ποιῆσαι.

controles.web: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.
controles.kjv: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
controles.livre: sob a condição de que nos lembrássemos dos pobres; isso também procurei fazer com empenho.

versos.grego: Ὅτε δὲ ἦλθεν Κηφᾶς εἰς Ἀντιόχειαν, κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτῷ ἀντέστην, ὅτι κατεγνωσμένος ἦν.

controles.web: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.
controles.kjv: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
controles.livre: E quando Cefas  veio a Antioquia, estive contra ele face a face, pois ele devia ser repreendido;

versos.grego: πρὸ τοῦ γὰρ ἐλθεῖν τινας ἀπὸ Ἰακώβου μετὰ τῶν ἐθνῶν συνήσθιεν· ὅτε δὲ ἦλθον, ὑπέστελλεν καὶ ἀφώριζεν ἑαυτόν, φοβούμενος τοὺς ἐκ περιτομῆς.

controles.web: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
controles.kjv: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
controles.livre: porque, antes que alguns que Tiago enviou chegassem, ele comia com os gentios; mas depois que chegaram, ele se retirou e se separou, temendo os que eram da circuncisão.

versos.grego: καὶ συνυπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ Ἰουδαῖοι, ὥστε καὶ Βαρνάβας συναπήχθη αὐτῶν τῇ ὑποκρίσει.

controles.web: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.
controles.kjv: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
controles.livre: E também com ele os outros judeus fingiram, de maneira que até Barnabé se deixou levar pela hipocrisia deles.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὅτε εἶδον ὅτι οὐκ ὀρθοποδοῦσιν πρὸς τὴν ἀλήθειαν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου, εἶπον τῷ Κηφᾷ ἔμπροσθεν πάντων Εἰ σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὑπάρχων ἐθνικῶς καὶ οὐκ Ἰουδαϊκῶς ζῇς, πῶς τὰ ἔθνη ἀναγκάζεις ἰουδαΐζειν;

controles.web: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?
controles.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?
controles.livre: Mas quando vi que não estavam agindo corretamente conforme a verdade do Evangelho, disse na presença de todos a Cefas:  “Se tu, que és judeu, vives como gentio, e não como judeu, como obrigas os gentios a viverem como judeus?”

versos.grego: Ἡμεῖς φύσει Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ οὐκ ἐξ ἐθνῶν ἁμαρτωλοί,

controles.web: “We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,
controles.kjv: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
controles.livre: Nós, que somos judeus por natureza, e não pecadores dentre os gentios,

versos.grego: εἰδότες δὲ ὅτι οὐ δικαιοῦται ἄνθρωπος ἐξ ἔργων νόμου ἐὰν μὴ διὰ πίστεως Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐπιστεύσαμεν, ἵνα δικαιωθῶμεν ἐκ πίστεως Χριστοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων νόμου, ὅτι ἐξ ἔργων νόμου οὐ δικαιωθήσεται πᾶσα σάρξ.

controles.web: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.
controles.kjv: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
controles.livre: sabemos que o ser humano não é justificado pelas obras da Lei, mas sim pela fé em Cristo Jesus.  Também nós temos crido em Cristo Jesus, para que fôssemos justificados pela fé em Cristo,  e não pelas obras da Lei; pois ninguém  se justificará pelas obras da Lei.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ζητοῦντες δικαιωθῆναι ἐν Χριστῷ εὑρέθημεν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἁμαρτωλοί, ἆρα Χριστὸς ἁμαρτίας διάκονος; μὴ γένοιτο.

controles.web: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!
controles.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.
controles.livre: Mas se nós, que buscamos ser justificados em Cristo, também nós mesmos somos achados pecadores, por isso Cristo contribui com o pecado?  De maneira nenhuma!

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ἃ κατέλυσα ταῦτα πάλιν οἰκοδομῶ, παραβάτην ἐμαυτὸν συνιστάνω.

controles.web: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.
controles.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
controles.livre: Pois, se volto a construir as coisas que já destruí, provo que eu mesmo cometi transgressão.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ γὰρ διὰ νόμου νόμῳ ἀπέθανον ἵνα Θεῷ ζήσω· Χριστῷ συνεσταύρωμαι·

controles.web: For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.
controles.kjv: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto God.
controles.livre: Pois pela Lei estou morto para a Lei, a fim de que eu viva para Deus.

versos.grego: ζῶ δὲ οὐκέτι ἐγώ, ζῇ δὲ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός· ὃ δὲ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί, ἐν πίστει ζῶ τῇ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἀγαπήσαντός με καὶ παραδόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ.

controles.web: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
controles.kjv: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself for me.
controles.livre: Já estou crucificado com Cristo. Estou vivendo não mais eu, mas Cristo vive em mim; e vivo a minha vida na carne por meio da fé no Filho de Deus,  que me amou, e entregou a si mesmo por mim.

versos.grego: Οὐκ ἀθετῶ τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ· εἰ γὰρ διὰ νόμου δικαιοσύνη, ἄρα Χριστὸς δωρεὰν ἀπέθανεν.

controles.web: I don’t make void the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
controles.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
controles.livre: Não anulo a graça  de Deus; pois, se a justiça  é por meio da Lei, logo Cristo morreu por nada.
